name: Beetoo
description: Beetoo was an R-series astromech droid who accompanied Jedi Master Jocasta Nu in the days following the proclamation of the New Order. The duo flew a gold Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor from Jocasta Nu's school to the Coruscant Underworld for Nu to infiltrate the former Jedi Temple to retrieve a list of Force-sensitive children across the galaxy.
